mapper.sql: select h.honor_id, h.honor_name, h.honor_type, h.award_date, h.award_level, h.award_org, h.description, h.del_flag, h.create_by, h.create_time, h.update_by, h.update_time, h.remark, h.certificate_no, h.certificate_url from honor h
mapper.select:
h.del_flag = '0'
and exists ( select 1 from honor_relation hr left join project p on hr.ref_type='PROJECT' and hr.ref_id = p.project_id and p.del_flag='0' left join sys_user su on hr.ref_type='RESEARCHER' and hr.ref_id = su.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = coalesce(p.dept_id, su.dept_id) left join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.leader_id where hr.honor_id = h.honor_id and hr.del_flag='0' ${params.dataScope} )
order by h.honor_id desc

h.del_flag = '0'
and ( exists (select 1 from honor_relation hr where hr.honor_id = h.honor_id and hr.del_flag='0' and hr.ref_type='RESEARCHER' and hr.ref_id = #{params.selfUserId}) or exists (select 1 from honor_relation hr join project p on hr.ref_id = p.project_id and p.del_flag='0' where hr.honor_id = h.honor_id and hr.del_flag='0' and hr.ref_type='PROJECT' and (p.leader_id = #{params.selfUserId} or exists (select 1 from project_member m where m.project_id = p.project_id and m.user_id = #{params.selfUserId} and m.del_flag='0'))) or h.create_by = #{params.selfUsername} )
order by h.honor_id desc
mapper.update: update honor set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate where honor_id = #{honorId} and del_flag = '0'
